title: Ontario man, 39, dies after taser used in arrest
article: A 39-year-old man is dead after Niagara Regional Police used a taser during his arrest -- only days after the force started using the stun guns.
The SIU said police went to a neighbourhood in Beamsville to arrest James Foldi. It was at that time the stun gun was drawn. Mr. Foldi later died in hospital. CP
